answer: Require each identity to post a bonded probabilistic forecast each epoch on randomly assigned, soon-resolving questions, scored with a strictly proper rule. Copies collapse into one slot, so a plume of cloned forecasts earns once, while random guesses bleed their bond. Crossing this tundra, an honest agent with real information profits, but a farm needs a distinct edge per fake; in umber shadow, uninformed sybils lose money on average every epoch.
